augments.name: Pyromania
augments.description: Fan the Flames now costs 1 more [65], but deals 5 additional damage per tick.
augments.note: Two deltas on one skill (cost + the dot's per-tick magnitude), so the whole skill is re-authored. '[65]' is the generic-energy cost icon (the same token appears on aramao1, an Earth hero, so it is not element-specific): generic 1 -> 2. 'per tick' = the Fan the Flames dot magnitude: 5 -> 10 (the 15 up-front hit is unchanged).

augments.name: Flickering Form
augments.description: Pyrrha heals for 10 health any time Fan the Flames expires or is removed.
augments.note: 'any time Fan the Flames expires OR is removed' -> two triggers: statusExpired (natural lapse) and statusLost (explicit removeStatus, e.g. Pyrokinesis consuming the burn or a cleanse). Both carry {kind,name}; the 'Fan the Flames' gate lives in the shared custom healIfExpiredStatusNamed (heals args.amount to args.to iff the leaving status is dot 'Fan the Flames'), which now accepts both event types.

augments.name: Unending Hunger
augments.description: Pyrokinesis will now consume Fan the Flames to deal 15 extra damage.
augments.note: Appended after Pyrokinesis' base tree. 'consume' = remove the Fan the Flames dot; the 15 extra damage is gated on the burn being present (you can only consume what is there). Extra damage typed Affliction to match Pyrokinesis (Affliction skill). Runs after the base +5-magnitude rider, so the dot is consumed last.

augments.name: Concussive Force
augments.description: Flashbang now fully stuns the targeted enemy
augments.note: Re-authors Flashbang so the target stun is a FULL stun (unscoped = all skills) instead of the base non-Strategic stun (scope {tag:'Strategic',mode:'except'}). Duration stays 1 turn (the augment only removes the Strategic carve-out); the self-Invulnerable-1 clause is unchanged.

augments.name: World in Flames
augments.description: While Wraith in White is active, Pyrrha deals 5 Affliction damage to the enemy team each turn.
augments.note: 'While Wraith in White is active' = while Pyrrha bears the 2-turn 'Wraith in White' self-mark (applied by her ultimate). 'each turn' -> a turnStart trigger gated on that mark. Known event-scoping gap (documented on saya1): turnStart fires for BOTH teams and no Condition reads event.team, so it currently ticks on every turn-start rather than only Pyrrha's. 'enemy team' = {faction:'enemies'}.

augments.name: Ashen Cleave
augments.description: Blade of Ashes strikes an additional random enemy for 10 damage. Has no effect if Blade of Ashes is AOE.
augments.note: Appended to Blade of Ashes. 'is AOE' = its Dancing-Lights branch (jarrik1 retargets to the whole enemy team while the caster bears the 'Dancing Lights' mark), so the extra strike is gated on NOT holding that mark. 'additional random enemy' approximated as a random living enemy: no selector excludes the primary target by identity, so the extra hit may coincide with it. Untyped 10 (normal), no Cinders mark (prose says damage only); it still procs the Cinders passive if the picked enemy already bears a Cinders mark.

augments.name: Charred and Crumbling
augments.description: Enemies affected by Blackened Wounds ignore healing for 1 turn.
augments.note: 'ignore healing' = the heal_lock status; 'affected by Blackened Wounds' = bears the named 'Blackened Wounds' status (a named marker, kind:'mark'). Authored as a standing rule: each turn, every enemy bearing Blackened Wounds is (re)heal_locked for 1 turn (the selector name-matches, which is legal — only Conditions cannot name-match). CAVEAT: no shipped Jarrik base skill applies a status named 'Blackened Wounds' (the kit centers on the 'Cinders' mark), so this trigger is dormant against the current base kit; the prose names 'Blackened Wounds' as the oracle and this transcribes it literally. turnStart double-fires (both teams) but that only re-applies the same heal_lock.

augments.name: Blazing Crescendo
augments.description: If all enemies affected by Cinderswell are marked by Cinders, they have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.
augments.note: Appended after Cinderswell's own effects. 'enemies affected by Cinderswell' = the enemies it hits = the living enemy team (Cinderswell is all-enemies). Condition 'all are marked by Cinders' = (count of enemies bearing Cinders) == (count of living enemies). 'non-Strategic skills stunned' = a stun scoped {tag:'Strategic',mode:'except'} for 1 turn on the whole enemy team. Empty enemy set makes the equality vacuously true and stuns nobody (harmless).

augments.name: Blackened Soul
augments.description: Jarrik splits all single-target damage received between him and any active Cinders.
augments.note: LAST-RESORT custom: no declarative op intercepts and REDISTRIBUTES incoming damage. The engine applies damage then emits damageDealt after the fact (a react trigger cannot un-apply it); incoming_damage_mod only scales the hit, it does not spread it to other units; and rulings.REDIRECT_DEPTH_CAP explicitly flags split damage as a special non-replicating case. The native handler (splitIncomingSingleTargetDamageAcrossCinders) intercepts single-target (non-AOE) damage aimed at Jarrik and divides it evenly between Jarrik and every enemy currently bearing a Cinders mark. Unregistered/dormant until that primitive exists.

patches.note: Split single-target damage received by Jarrik evenly across Jarrik + all units bearing an active Cinders mark.

augments.name: Dazzling Lights
augments.description: While Blade of Dancing Lights is active, Cinder minions ignore harmful skills.
augments.note: 'Blade of Dancing Lights is active' = Jarrik bears the 'Dancing Lights' mark (his ultimate applies it for a computed number of turns). 'Cinder minions' = his Cinderling minions. 'ignore harmful skills' modeled as Invulnerable (immune to new Harmful skills) — the same approximation used for gommar4/pyrrha4's 'invulnerable to non-strategic skills'. Re-applied on turnStart while the mark holds; because turnStart fires for BOTH teams (the standard event-scoping gap), the enemy's turnStart also refreshes the duration-1 Invulnerable, so the minions stay covered through the enemy's turn (when harmful skills land) as well as Jarrik's. Newly auto-summoned Cinderlings are picked up at the next turnStart.

augments.name: Icy Shrapnel
augments.description: Iceblood Hammer and Foot of the Mountain now mark a random enemy on use. The following turn, that enemy will take 20 damage.
augments.note: Appended to BOTH named skills. 'mark a random enemy' = a 1-turn 'Icy Shrapnel' mark on a random living enemy; 'the following turn take 20 damage' = the mark's onExpire (fires when the 1-turn mark lapses, i.e. at Gommar's next turn-end per DURATION_ANCHOR). onExpire runs with the marked enemy bound as its target, so damage 'to:target' lands on it. Chose mark+onExpire over a bare schedule so the visible mark the prose calls for actually exists and carries the payload. Damage typed normal (untyped in prose).

augments.name: Frozen Fortress
augments.description: While Frost-Covered, Gommar gains 10 points of DR
augments.note: 'DR' = the damage_reduction status (10 points of magnitude). 'While Frost-Covered' = while Gommar bears the 'Frost-Covered' mark. Modeled as a turnStart trigger that refreshes a duration-1 damage_reduction 10 while the mark holds (the 'while X' pattern); because turnStart fires for both teams, DR is refreshed at both his and the enemy's turn-start, keeping it up on the enemy's turn (when they attack) and lapsing within a turn if Frost-Covered is ever lost. damage_reduction refreshes (does not stack), so it stays at 10.

augments.name: Winter's Howl
augments.description: Breath of the North now lowers the targets damage by 15, lowered by 5 every time they use a skill.
augments.note: Re-authors Breath of the North so its outgoing_damage_mod is -15 (up from -5) and named 'Winter's Howl' (so the decay scopes to exactly this debuff, not the -5 mods Gommar's other skills leave). Duration made permanent (null): with no turn-duration in the prose, the debuff is spent down by the target's skill uses, not by a clock. The Frost-Covered piercing/normal branch and the uncounterableIf gate are preserved. Second patch: a skillUsed trigger decays it +5 toward 0 each time the debuffed enemy uses a skill (-15 -> -10 -> -5 -> 0), guarded by {statusMag('Winter's Howl') < 0} so it floors at 0 and never overshoots into a positive (a damage BUFF) on the 4th+ use.

augments.name: Flashfreeze
augments.description: After Gommar consumes Frost-Covered, he regains it at the end of his next turn.
augments.note: Reactive on Gommar CONSUMING Frost-Covered: keys on statusLost (the explicit-removal event emitted by the removeStatus op), since Frost-Covered is a dur-null mark that never naturally expires (statusExpired would never fire). regainFrostCoveredNextTurn gates on eventUnit==self + kind/name, then schedules applyStatus Frost-Covered to self at the end of his next turn (delayTurns 1). Gommar's base actives gommar1/2/3/5 consume the charge via removeStatus, so this now fires.

effect.note: If Gommar lost the Frost-Covered mark, schedule applyStatus Frost-Covered to self at the end of his next turn.

augments.name: Brittle Ice
augments.description: Iceblood Hammer deals 5 less damage and costs one fewer r each time it is used, stacking up to twice.
augments.note: Re-authors Iceblood Hammer with a per-use decay tracked by a 'Brittle Ice' self-stack (capped at 2). Damage = 20 - 5*min(stacks,2) and the counter is incremented AFTER the damage reads it, so successive casts deal 20, 15, 10, 10... (first cast full, then 5 less each, up to -10). 'r' = the generic-energy cost icon (Iceblood Hammer's only nonzero cost is its 2 generic). The cost half is a skillId-scoped cost_mod, which the declarative StatusSpec cannot express (no skillId field) — so it is a custom node mirroring syl's decaySkillCost: -1 generic per use, floored at -2 (base cost stays 2; effectiveCost applies the discount, which lands on the NEXT cast). Other base effects (the -5 outgoing_damage_mod and the Frost-Covered team-hit) are preserved.

effects.name: Frost-Covered
effects.note: Consume the Frost-Covered enhance charge (base Iceblood Hammer behavior the replaceSkill had dropped). The 'costs one fewer per use' discount is the declarative costMods above (-1 generic per Brittle Ice stack, capped 2), read at cast time before this cast adds its stack.

augments.name: Riveting Read
augments.description: If Keeper of Fables still has Shield on Tales to Tell after using Page-turner, the targeted enemy is stunned for 1 turn. Page-turner's cooldown is increased by 1.
augments.note: Two changes to Page-turner (keeper1). Rider: after the skill resolves (25 Shield already consumed by the base skill), if any Shield remains on Keeper's pool, stun the target 1 turn. 'still has Shield ... after using Page-turner' = ref:shield of caster > 0 measured at the end of the effect tree. Edge: if Page-turner whiffed (Shield < 25, nothing consumed) but Keeper still holds 1-24 Shield, this over-fires; the intended case is a successful Page-turner leaving a remainder. Cooldown 'increased by 1' from base 0 -> 1 via setSkillMeta.

augments.name: Flat Design
augments.description: If Character Development targets an ally it hasn't targeted yet this round, Keeper of Fables gains Elemental Essence.
augments.note: Appends to Character Development (keeper2). 'hasn't targeted yet this round' is tracked with a round-permanent mark 'Flat Design' placed on each ally the skill targets; duration null = cleared at round end, so the who-has-been-targeted set resets every round (matches 'this round'). Fires on targeting regardless of whether the 25-Shield heal actually landed, per the prose ('targets an ally').

augments.name: Plot Twist
augments.description: If Keeper of Fables is the only living Hero you control, Hero's Return only consumes 50 Shield and costs one less [65].
augments.note: Both changes to Hero's Return (keeper5) are gated on 'Keeper is the only living Hero you control' = exactly one living allied hero (himself): count{faction allies, kind hero, includeSelf} == 1. The Shield-consumption change (75 -> 50) is expressible inside the effect tree, so it is re-authored via replaceSkill: when solo, guard Shield>=50 / consume 50 / revive; otherwise the base guard Shield>=75 / consume 75 / revive. The conditional cost reduction is NOT expressible statically (setSkillMeta cost is unconditional; no cost Value can read the solo state at cast time), so it is a custom patch. DATA TENSION: [65] = Generic energy, but Hero's Return's base cost is {generic:0, specific:2} (2 of Keeper's element), so 'one less Generic' has no Generic component to remove -- transcribed literally as a -1 Generic conditional discount; designer clarification needed on whether it should reduce the Specific cost instead.

skill.name: Hero's Return
skill.note: Plot Twist: when Keeper is the sole living allied hero, consume only 50 Shield (else the base 75). Targets a DEAD ally (revive no-ops on a living unit). Consume via the consumeShield custom (no shield-spend primitive), same pattern as the base skill.

patches.note: 'costs one less [65]' (Generic) while Keeper is the only living allied hero — a per-cast conditional costMod on keeper5 (see conditionalCostReduction). The `when` matches keeper5's own solo gate (count of living ally heroes == 1). effectiveCost re-evaluates it live each cast. RULING: keeper5's base cost has no Generic component, so the -1 Generic spills onto the Specific cost (the engine's universal cost_mod convention) — i.e. solo Hero's Return costs one Specific less. This preserves the discount (the intended 'cheaper when solo' effect) rather than making it a no-op; kept intentionally over a literal 'floor Generic at 0' reading.

augments.name: Good Pacing
augments.description: Shield from Tales to Tell can only take a maximum of 20 damage from a single hit.
augments.note: A per-hit absorption cap on Keeper's Shield pool: any single incoming hit can spend at most 20 of his Shield (overflow falls through to HP). This is a damage-pipeline modifier, not a skill effect or a post-hoc trigger (damageDealt fires after absorption is decided), and there is no status kind for 'cap shield absorption per hit'. Modeled as a custom registered on the unit -- ENGINE GAP: needs a shield-absorption hook in the damage step. patch_map targets the passive Tales to Tell (keeper0), which has no active effect tree to append to.

patches.note: Cap Keeper's Shield absorption at 20 per single hit. Requires a damage-step hook the engine does not expose yet (fidelity debt).

augments.name: Nose in a Book
augments.description: If Keeper of Fables doesn't act during his turn, he heals his team for 5 health.
augments.note: Reactive at his own team's turn-end: if Keeper is not in actedThisTurn, heal the allied team (incl. self) 5. There is no Condition for 'self acted this turn' and no way to gate a turnEnd trigger to the owner's own team, so both checks live in the custom (mirrors the blackknight 'exileActingAlone' pattern, which reads ctx.state.actedThisTurn and ctx.event.team).

effect.note: Fires only on Keeper's own team turnEnd; if Keeper did not act this turn, heal {faction:allies, includeSelf} for 5.

augments.name: Crushing Depths
augments.description: Enemies who have been stunned by Undertow take 10 affliction damage each turn for the rest of the game.
augments.note: Re-authors Undertow (riverdaughter2) to attach a permanent 10-affliction DoT to a target it stuns. The base skill's stun lives inside an 'if has mark Undertow Stun of self' branch that also consumes the mark, so the DoT is injected into that same branch (an appendEffect at top level would run after the mark is cleared) -- hence replaceSkill. 'for the rest of the game' = duration null (round-permanent). NOTE: statuses reset each round per the rulings, so a truly cross-round DoT is not expressible; round-permanent is the closest. DoT dtype is affliction (bypasses Shield/DR), matching 'affliction damage'.

skill.name: Undertow
skill.note: Base Undertow + Crushing Depths rider: when Undertow's stun lands, also apply a permanent 10 affliction DoT 'Crushing Depths' to the stunned target.

augments.name: Balm
augments.description: When Soothe expires, it will attempt to jump to an ally that doesn't currently have it.
augments.note: Reactive: when the Soothe regen expires on any ally, re-apply Soothe (10/turn, 2 turns) to a random ally that lacks it -> perpetual chaining (each jumped copy re-fires this trigger on its own expiry). Implemented as a statusExpired trigger + custom because there is no Condition to gate a statusExpired trigger on the expired status's kind+name (same limitation the base passives note); the custom checks ctx.event is the Soothe regen expiry before hopping. 'an ally that doesn't currently have it' = pick random from {allies incl. self} filtered without a Soothe regen.

effect.note: If the expired status is the Soothe regen, apply Soothe (10/turn, 2 turns) to a random ally without it. No-op if every ally already has it.

augments.name: Trickster Clone
augments.description: If River Clone expires without being triggered, it will attempt to jump to an ally that doesn't currently have it.
augments.note: Same jump mechanism as Balm, keyed on the 'River Clone' mark. The base River Clone counter consumes the mark (removeStatus) when it triggers, so a natural expiry = the mark was never triggered. Modeled as a statusExpired trigger + custom (no Condition gates statusExpired by status name). AMBIGUITY: the base authoring places the 'River Clone' mark on an ENEMY (arming the counter) with duration null (round-permanent), so its only natural 'expiry' is at round end; yet the augment says jump to 'an ally'. Transcribed literally per the oracle (reapply to a random ally without it); the enemy-placement vs 'ally' target conflict needs designer clarification.

effect.note: If the 'River Clone' mark expired without being triggered, reapply it to a random unit without it. See augment note re: base marks an enemy but prose says 'ally'.

augments.name: Restorative Retreat
augments.description: River Daughter heals 20 health for 2 turns when she uses Dive.
augments.note: Appends to Dive (riverdaughter5): apply a 20/turn regen for 2 turns to River Daughter. '20 health for 2 turns' read as a heal-over-time (20 per turn, 2 turns), the twin idiom of the base kit's regen buffs.

augments.name: River Within
augments.description: Whenever River Clone is triggered, River Daughter casts Ripple.
augments.note: 'River Clone is triggered' = its counter fires. The base River Clone counter is River Daughter's ONLY counter, so a counterFired with eventSource == self uniquely identifies it (there is no per-counter identity on counterFired). On that event, cast Ripple (riverdaughter1) via useSkill by self. Ripple is all-enemies, so no target is needed; the cast is reactive/free (no cost or cooldown gate in this transcription).

augments.name: Atlantean Waters
augments.description: While Zev'kir is Channeling Call Tides, he heals 5 HP per turn and ignores stuns.
augments.note: Call Tides (zevkir1) is a Channel whose effects re-run each channel turn, so appending to it IS 'while Channeling Call Tides, each turn'. The 5 HP/turn heal is a clean appended heal. 'ignores stuns' = a real 'Stun Immunity' mark (isStunnedFor honors it) refreshed each channel tick with duration 1, so Zev'kir is immune THROUGHOUT the channel (a stun landing between his ticks no longer stuns him) -- true immunity, not a post-hoc wipe.

effect.note: 'ignores stuns' = a real 'Stun Immunity' mark (isStunnedFor honors it) refreshed each channel tick with duration 1, so Zev'kir is immune THROUGHOUT the channel (a stun landing between his ticks no longer stuns him), not merely wiped after the fact.

augments.name: Airless Prison
augments.description: If Zev'kir has 2 or more stacks of Call Tides, Bubble Prison increases affected enemy skill costs by 1 [65]. If he has 4 or more stacks, they are increased by 1 Energy of the target's Element instead.
augments.note: Appends to Bubble Prison (zevkir3). At >=2 Call Tides stacks, apply a cost_mod to the affected enemy/enemies; the affected set mirrors Bubble Prison's target rule (Oceans Gather makes it all-enemies at >=3 stacks, else the single target). Tiers: ==2 single target +1 Generic; ==3 all enemies +1 Generic; >=4 all enemies +1 of the target's own Element (specificDelta, replacing the Generic bump). Duration matches the imprisonment: 1 + Call Tides stacks turns (same expression as the base DoT).

then.note: >=4 stacks (all enemies via Oceans Gather): +1 to each target's own Element cost INSTEAD of Generic. Specific cost is always paid in the caster's own element, so specificDelta:1 == '+1 Energy of the target's Element'.

else.note: 3 stacks (all enemies via Oceans Gather): +1 Generic [65] to every affected enemy's skill costs.
>=2 stacks (single target): +1 Generic [65] to the target's skill costs.

augments.name: Piercing Tide
augments.description: If Zev'kir has 2 or more stacks of Call Tides, Riptide deals Piercing damage. If he has 4 or more stacks, it deals Affliction damage instead.
augments.note: Re-authors Riptide (zevkir2) to switch its damage TYPE by Call Tides stacks: >=4 -> affliction, 2-3 -> piercing, else normal. dtype is a literal field (not a Value), so the three variants are expressed as nested stack-threshold branches. Damage amount (5 + 10/stack), the Oceans Gather >=3 all-enemies split, and the >=2 stun are preserved from the base. Since >=4 implies >=3, the affliction case always hits all enemies.

skill.name: Riptide
skill.note: Piercing Tide: damage type is normal (<2 stacks), piercing (2-3), or affliction (>=4). Amount = 5 + 10 per Call Tides stack; >=3 hits all enemies; >=2 stuns the primary target.

augments.name: Storm Surge
augments.description: Tidal Wave deals 20 less damage, but its base cost is reduced by 2 Specific energy
augments.note: Re-authors Tidal Wave (zevkir5): damage 45 -> 25 (piercing) and base Specific cost 5 -> 3. Both are static tweaks, folded into one replaceSkill. The Oceans Gather >=3 all-enemies split and the >=2 stun are preserved. The base note's dynamic '1 less Specific per Call Tides stack' remains a documented cost behavior on top of the new base cost of 3.

skill.name: Tidal Wave
skill.note: Storm Surge: 25 piercing (was 45); base Specific cost reduced by 2 (5 -> 3). Per-stack Specific reduction (-1 per Call Tides stack, min 0) preserved via costMods, matching the base skill. Oceans Gather: >=2 stacks stun primary 1 turn; >=3 stacks hit all enemies.

augments.name: Arcane Barrier
augments.description: While Repulse is not on cooldown, Zev'kir gains 15 Shield that replenishes at the start of his turn.
augments.note: At the start of Zev'kir's turn, if Repulse (zevkir4) is off cooldown, refresh a 15-Shield barrier. 'While Repulse is not on cooldown' cannot be tested by any Condition (no skill-cooldown Condition or Value exists), and 'replenishes' (top up to 15, not stack) needs the prior barrier removed first, so both live in a custom on a turnStart trigger. ENGINE GAP: needs a cooldown-state read; the custom gates on ctx.event being Zev'kir's own turnStart and zevkir4.currentCd == 0.

effect.note: On Zev'kir's own turnStart, if Repulse (zevkir4) is not on cooldown, remove the prior Arcane Barrier shield and grant a fresh 15 Shield.

augments.name: Royalties
augments.description: When Saya gives an ally Elemental Essence with Universal Energy Conduit, she also gains Elemental Essence
augments.note: Universal Energy Conduit's turn-end grant applies elemental_essence to a random ally (source = Saya). This couples a self-grant to THAT event (not to Saya1's cast): whenever Saya applies elemental_essence to an ALLY (not herself), she also gains one. Gated eventUnit != self so Saya's own grant does not re-fire (no loop).

augments.name: Link Coils
augments.description: Saya Coil deals an additional 5 damage for every Saya Coil she has active
augments.note: Saya Coil's damage is a recurring end-of-turn hit (not an on-cast, addressable node) and 'active Saya Coils' is a live count, so no appendEffect/setSkillMeta/replaceSkill op can retune the existing per-tick amount. A custom handler adds 5 damage to each Saya Coil hit for every active Saya Coil.

augments.name: What's Mine is Yours
augments.description: Spider Mines now affects a single enemy, but only lasts for one turn.
augments.note: Whole-skill re-author (base nodes have no ids). Targeting changes from self (two/three random enemy heroes) to a single chosen enemy, and the mine now expires after 1 turn (duration 1). The mine is laid via addStack (kind 'stack', name 'Spider Mine') exactly like the base skill, so the base Spider Mines detonation hero trigger (which reads stackCount 'Spider Mine' of eventSource and consumes it) fires end-to-end; a plain mark would be invisible to stackCount. The base's random two-mine placement and the 'While Enhanced, three Spider Mines' clause are superseded.

augments.name: Kinetic Converter
augments.description: Reduces the cooldown of Plasma Shield to 1 turn, but reduces the shield it grants to 25.
augments.note: Whole-skill re-author captures the augment's two value changes: cooldown 3 -> 1 and shield 40 -> 25. 'Ignores affliction damage for 1 turn' is modeled via a custom. isHidden is preserved (base saya4 is Invisible, and the visibility system now honors it end-to-end) and the base's Enhanced->Plasma Charge on-cast branch is preserved — the replaceSkill must carry every base clause it does not intend to change.

augments.name: Hair Trigger
augments.description: Well-Used Panic Button will now trigger when Saya falls below 60 health.
augments.note: Well-Used Panic Button is a reactive passive that fires the first time Saya drops below a health threshold due to damage; this augment changes only that threshold from 40 to 60. There is no op to edit a base trigger's condition value in place (removeTrigger+addTrigger would require re-authoring the whole 'arm next Stroke of Genius to detonate all inventions' passive, whose 'inventions' count has no clean selector), so a custom retunes just the threshold.

augments.name: Afterimage
augments.description: If Ando uses Flash Step while Uncharged, he becomes invulnerable to non-strategic skills for 1 turn.
augments.note: 'Uncharged' = holding neither the Charged nor the Supercharged state mark. 'Invulnerable to non-strategic skills' maps to the `invulnerable` status, which already blocks only NEW harmful (i.e. non-Strategic) skills. Appended to Flash Step (ando2). Exact base charge-state mark names govern firing.

augments.name: Static Repulsion
augments.description: When Ando uses Focus Power, he gains 5 DR for 2 turns for each target marked by Electroblade.
augments.note: Appended to Focus Power (ando4). Grants one damage_reduction status whose magnitude is 5 x (number of enemies marked by Electroblade), lasting 2 turns.

augments.name: Pulse Blade
augments.description: Expel Energy also marks its target and another random target with Electroblade.
augments.note: Appended to Expel Energy (ando3): marks the chosen target plus one additional random enemy with Electroblade (permanent marks).

augments.name: On the Clock
augments.description: Overclock is now permanent, but Ando receives 15 Affliction damage when he uses a Supercharged ability.
augments.note: 'Now permanent' = Overclock's on-cast window mark is applied with null (round-permanent) duration instead of 3 turns; the base per-turn 'after a Supercharged skill -> become Charged + gain Essence' reactive is a hero trigger reading this Overclock window mark and is unaffected. 'Extends his current Supercharge by 1 turn' and 'usable only while Supercharged' are preserved on the re-authored skill. The drawback is a reactive trigger: 15 Affliction self-damage when Ando casts while Supercharged. skillUsed carries no class tags, so 'Supercharged ability' is approximated as any skill Ando casts while holding the Supercharged state (sameUnit + Supercharged mark). Exact base mark names govern.

augments.name: Singular Directive
augments.description: While Ando is Charged or Supercharged, he ignores Counters and Reflects.
augments.note: 'Ignores Counters and Reflects' = his skills become Uncounterable while he holds the Charged OR Supercharged state; modeled via each skill's `uncounterableIf` (a conditional Uncounterable, evaluated at declaration with Ando as self). Applied to his counterable Harmful skills — Electroblade (ando1), Flash Step (ando2), Expel Energy (ando3); his Strategic self-casts (Focus Power, Overclock) aren't valid counter/reflect targets, so they're left unpatched. Exact base charge-state mark names govern.

augments.name: Blade of Romance
augments.description: If Arcadian Duet targets a different enemy than its last target, Zephyrex gains Elemental Essence.
augments.note: 'Different enemy than its last target' is tracked with an `Arcadian Target` mark parked on the previously-targeted enemy: if the new target lacks that mark it differs from last time and Zephyrex gains Essence; the mark is then cleared from all enemies and moved onto the current target. Fires on the first-ever cast (no prior target). Appended to Arcadian Duet (zephyrex1), so its base Invulnerable + Isolated remain.

augments.name: Blade of Symphonies
augments.description: Using Sonic Thrust on an enemy will also use Arcadian Duet on them.
augments.note: Appended to Sonic Thrust (zephyrex3): after its base effect, inline-invokes Arcadian Duet (zephyrex1) on the same target (applying Invulnerable + Isolated).

augments.name: Wind Dancer
augments.description: Wind Step now targets an enemy, lowering their non-Affliction damage by 10 for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill during this time, Zephyrex gains Elemental Essence. This effect is invisible.
augments.note: Wind Step (zephyrex4) is redefined from a self-buff to an enemy debuff: it now targets an enemy and lowers their non-Affliction damage by 10 for 1 turn — modeled via `outgoing_damage_mod` magnitude -10 (which the engine applies to normal/piercing only, i.e. non-Affliction). A `Wind Dancer` mark tags that enemy; a skillUsed trigger grants Zephyrex Essence when the marked enemy uses a Harmful skill (skillUsed carries no tags, so eventHasTag supplies the Harmful check). This replaces the base Wind Step's self-15-DR and its receives-a-skill->Essence behavior. 'This effect is invisible' is real: the replacement skill is isHidden, so the whole enemy-side application (the -10 debuff and the Wind Dancer mark) is stamped invisible and hidden from the opponent by redactState, and the cast leaves no telegraph. Sonic Thrust's 'usable only if Wind Step is on cooldown' still holds (cooldown unchanged at 2).

augments.name: Zephyr Blade
augments.description: Perfection now grants Zephyrex immunity to Stuns.
augments.note: Perfect Execution (zephyrex5) applies Perfection (until the end of Zephyrex's next turn); this augment makes Perfection also confer Stun immunity. The engine has no Stun-specific immunity (the nearest status, `non_damage_ignore`, would over-broadly block ALL harmful non-damage effects), so a custom grants Stun immunity for Perfection's duration. Appended to Perfect Execution so it fires each cast, mirroring Perfection's refresh.

augments.name: Polite Denial
augments.description: Elegant Sweep is now invisible, and Zephyrex gains the effect of Wind Step while it is active.
augments.note: 'Gains the effect of Wind Step while active' = Zephyrex gets Wind Step's core self-buff, 15 damage-reduction, for the duration of the Elegant Sweep channel; applied on cast (appended to zephyrex2). 'Elegant Sweep is now invisible' = setSkillMeta isHidden on zephyrex2: the cast leaves no telegraph and every status it applies is stamped invisible (redactState hides them from the opponent).

augments.name: Voracious Growth
augments.description: Successfully healing Syl's Eagle Minion with Feed lowers the cost of Leyline Nest by [4] until the next time it is used.
augments.note: Feed=syl1, Leyline Nest=syl5. Reduction is scoped to a single skill until its next use — the same shape as base Leyline Nest's per-skill dynamic cost (decaySkillCost/resetScopedCostMod), which no cost primitive expresses, so a custom is used and the existing on-use reset trigger clears it. '[4]' read as magnitude 4 (wind), matching the bracket-as-magnitude precedent.

effect.note: Lowers Leyline Nest's wind cost by 4 until it is next used; 'successfully healing' is not strictly gated (Feed's heal is a no-op with no living Eagle).

augments.name: Wonder by Wonder
augments.description: To the Skies! now lasts an additional turn.
augments.note: To the Skies!=syl3. Its empowerment is the duration-0 'To the Skies' mark placed on the Eagle; '+1 turn' = duration 0 -> 1. Base skill node has no id, so replaceSkill re-authors the whole skill.

augments.name: Plummet
augments.description: Enemies stunned by Talon Rake receive 15 damage when the stun ends.
augments.note: Talon Rake=sylminion1 (Syl's Eagle minion skill). Its stun is only applied when empowered by To the Skies!, so 'stunned by Talon Rake' == that same stun node. Modeled by giving that stun an onExpire that deals 15 — the DSL's 'when this status ends' hook. replaceSkill re-authors the minion skill; assumes minion skill ids are addressable by patches.

onExpire.note: onExpire runs on the stunned enemy; 'self' assumes the holder binding — the exact onExpire self-binding governs whether the 15 lands on the ex-stunned unit.

augments.name: You and Me
augments.description: Unbreakable Bond now heals Syl and her Eagle for 10 health after health has been equalized.
augments.note: Unbreakable Bond=syl4 (custom equalizeHp). appendEffect runs after the base equalize, healing both Syl and her Eagle for 10.

augments.name: Shish Kebab
augments.description: Skylance now heals Syl's Eagle minion for 10 health. If her Eagle minion is at maximum life after the heal, she gains Elemental Essence.
augments.note: Skylance=syl2. appendEffect mirrors Feed's base pattern: heal the Eagle 10, then 'at maximum life' == missingHp==0 grants Syl Elemental Essence (no maxHp Value ref exists).

augments.name: Overeager
augments.description: At the start of each round, Hector automatically casts Burning Blood Serum on Dennis.
augments.note: Burning Blood Serum=hector1. Reactive roundStart cast on the Dennis the Apprentice minion (Hector's passive re-summons Dennis at roundStart; this fires alongside it). When hero-Dennis shares the team his passive rewrites the reference — a cross-hero rule not expressible from Hector's side.

augments.name: Calibrated Syringe Gun
augments.description: Hector's Serum skills cannot be stunned.
augments.note: 'Cannot be stunned' == the frozen 'Unstunnable' skill class/tag. Applied to Hector's three injectable serums (hector1 Burning Blood, hector2 Stoneseal, hector3 Mindfog); Serum Overload (hector5) is excluded as it applies no serum. setSkillMeta.tags is absolute, so each existing tag list is restated with 'Unstunnable' added.

augments.name: Dilution
augments.description: Serums now last for 2 additional turns, but their costs are increased by [65].
augments.note: 'Serums' = the three injectable serums (hector1/2/3); each applied status' duration goes 3 -> 5 ('2 additional turns'). '[65]' read as magnitude 65 in the hero's element (poison/specific) pool, matching the bracket-as-magnitude precedent (syl1 '[4]' == cost 4); 65 is anomalously large — likely a UI value/icon-token artifact — so the exact pool and magnitude are uncertain. Serum Overload's explicit refresh-to-3 (hector5) is left unchanged.

effects.note: Mindfog's removable '+1 to cooldowns' drawback, duration 3 -> 5; no lasting cooldown-modifier StatusKind exists.

augments.name: Promotion
augments.description: Dennis the Apprentice begins the game with 20 extra health, and under the effect of a random Serum
augments.note: Modifies Dennis's spawn. '+20 max health' has no maxHp-buff effect primitive; 'a random Serum' has no random-skill-selection primitive — both are customs on the roundStart spawn (Dennis is re-summoned each round by Hector's passive).

effect.note: Dennis begins with +20 max health; no maxHp-buff primitive.
'under the effect of a random Serum' — casts one of Hector's three serums on Dennis at random; no random-skill primitive.

augments.name: Emergency Clinic
augments.description: Hector may use his Serums on targets other than Dennis once Dennis has died.
augments.note: Lifts the Dennis-only targeting restriction on the serums (hector1/2/3) once Dennis is dead. The 'only Dennis' restriction is itself an unencoded design rule (the serums' base targeting is already 'single'), so relaxing it is a custom.

patches.note: After Dennis dies, Hector's serums may target any single unit rather than only Dennis.

augments.name: Auto-Injectors
augments.description: Dennis will automatically use HS-46 Ascendant Serum on himself any time he receives a stun effect.
augments.note: HS-46 Ascendant Serum=dennis3. Reactive on statusApplied to Dennis, gated on the APPLIED status being a stun (eventStatusKind:'stun') so it fires only when a stun lands, not on any status while Dennis happens to hold one. HS-46 applies no stun, so no loop.

augments.name: Rage Response
augments.description: Dennis will automatically use HS-112 Fury Serum on himself if an allied Hero dies. If that Hero was Hector the Injector, Dennis uses End of Shift instead.
augments.note: HS-112 Fury Serum=dennis2, End of Shift=dennis6. Reactive on unitDied for an allied hero (not Dennis himself). 'that Hero was Hector' has no hero-id selector; the template:'hector' hint on the ally-hero selector is the intended discriminator but is not enforced by the DSL, so the Hector branch depends on the engine honoring that hint.

effect.note: then = the dead ally hero is Hector (End of Shift); else = any other ally hero (Fury Serum). Hector discrimination relies on the unenforced template hint.

augments.name: Long Memory
augments.description: Pain Tolerance now lasts for 2 turns.
augments.note: Pain Tolerance is the hero passive/trigger (source 'Pain Tolerance'), not a skill — so it is retuned by removing the base trigger and re-adding it with the stack and Damage Reduction durations 1 -> 2. The once-per-turn Elemental Essence guard mark stays duration 1.

augments.name: Dennis So Popular Now
augments.description: Shared Agony now costs 1 Generic energy, but both parts of its activation now include all allied units.
augments.note: Shared Agony=dennis4. Cost -> {generic:1, specific:0}. 'Both parts include all allied units': part 1 (Dennis deals 5 to all enemies) becomes each allied unit dealing 5 to all enemies; part 2 (all enemies deal 5 Piercing to Dennis) becomes each enemy dealing 5 Piercing to all allied units. Whole-skill re-author via replaceSkill. Each fanned hit is credited to its real dealer via from:'it' (the ally for part 1, the enemy for part 2), so damager-identity reactions (e.g. Fury) see the true source.

augments.name: Working for Weekend
augments.description: Big Green Fist deals 5 more base damage, and decreases the remaining cooldown of End of Shift by 1 turn.
augments.note: Big Green Fist=dennis1, End of Shift=dennis6. '5 more base damage' raises the base literal 10 -> 15 in both branches (the HS-46 +10 is unchanged) via replaceSkill. 'Decreases the remaining cooldown of End of Shift by 1' fires on each cast, appended as a modifyCooldown.

augments.name: In On The Joke
augments.description: Allies affected by Laughing Powder also gain the effects of Whimsy.
augments.note: Whimsy (Titania's passive) is realized as the stealth status ('does not trigger enemy effects'). Reactive rule: whenever the Laughing Powder DoT lands on an ally, grant that ally stealth for as long as the powder remains. statusApplied fires after the status lands, so eventUnit already holds the DoT; the has-DoT gate keys off it and the isFaction gate restricts to Titania's team.

augments.name: Bloody Humor
augments.description: Enemies under the effect of Barbed Wit now receive 15 Affliction damage when they use a Harmful skill on Titania, and Barbed Wit no longer ends when this occurs.
augments.note: Removes the base 'Barbed Wit' early-end trigger (the taunt no longer drops when the taunted enemy hits Titania) and adds a 15 Affliction retaliation. 'Harmful' is not tag-checkable on skillUsed, but it is naturally satisfied: taunt (unitRef=caster) only redirects Harmful single-target skills onto Titania, so a taunted enemy acting on her is the harmful hit the prose describes (same reasoning as the base kit).

augments.name: Elderwood Sap
augments.description: Thorn Prick no longer deals initial damage, but its affliction damage is doubled.
augments.note: Re-authored Thorn Prick: drops the 10 normal initial hit and doubles the affliction DoT magnitude (5 -> 10). Same null-duration DoT tick caveat as the base skill (a permanent affliction DoT).

augments.name: Persistent Suitor
augments.description: Titania starts each round with a Summer Courtesan, but her maximum is reduced to 1.
augments.note: Minions clear each round, so a roundStart summon of one Summer Courtesan opens every battle with exactly one. Summer Clique is re-authored to cap living Courtesans at 1 (count-gate mirrors Sprout Seedling's < N cap), still clearing Prance stacks on use as the base does.

augments.name: Jealousy
augments.description: If Prance is triggered by one of Titania's allies, the following turn, the other ally will have their basic abilities' Specific costs changed to Generic
augments.note: Rebuilds the base 'Prance' trigger (so the two branches don't fight over consuming the Prance Watch mark) and appends a Jealousy branch that fires only when the unit that triggered Prance is an ally. 'The other ally' (the allied hero that is neither the Prance-triggering ally nor Titania) and 'basic abilities' Specific costs changed to Generic' (a cost-type conversion, not a magnitude delta) are beyond the declarative selector/cost vocabulary, so the branch calls a custom effect. 'The following turn' is left to the handler (duration/schedule ~1 turn).

args.note: convert the OTHER ally hero's (not eventSource, not self) basic-skill Specific costs to Generic for the following turn

augments.name: Yggdrasil's Guidance
augments.description: At the start of the game, Gaia creates a Worldsprout minion instead of a Seedling.
augments.note: The base passive 'Yggdrasil's Bounty' summons two Seedlings at round start; this swaps one for a Worldsprout (1 Seedling + 1 Worldsprout). Realized by replacing the base roundStart trigger. 'Start of the game' = start of each round (fresh-battle rounds).

augments.name: Earthen Aid
augments.description: Channel Earth heals a random ally for 10 HP
augments.note: Appends a 10 HP heal to a random ally onto Channel Earth (the Seedling's skill, seedling1). 'Ally' = a random unit on Gaia's team (from the acting Seedling's perspective).

augments.name: Stonepod Seedlings
augments.description: Gaia's minions are created with 10 more maximum HP.
augments.note: No declarative op edits a minion template's HP, and this is a template-wide +10 max HP spanning both of Gaia's templates (Seedling, Worldsprout) and every creation path (passive summons, Sprout Seedling, Worldmarch transform), so it is a custom patch. Handler must add +10 to the maxHp (and starting HP) of minions Gaia creates. ENGINE GAP: no minion-template patch primitive.

augments.name: Destructive Divergence
augments.description: Each time Channel Vitality is triggered, Gaia gains a stack of Channel Earth.
augments.note: Read as: each use of the Channel Vitality skill (gaia3) grants Gaia +1 permanent Channel Earth stack (the resource Worldfist/Rampart scale off). caster = Gaia, who owns gaia3. ALT reading: 'triggered' = the base Channel Vitality reactive trigger firing when an allied minion acts; that would instead be a mirrored skillUsed trigger (isKind eventSource minion + isFaction ally) adding the stack to self.

augments.name: Soul Channeling
augments.description: Gaia now starts the round with 3 Seedlings
augments.note: Base passive 'Yggdrasil's Bounty' summons 2 Seedlings at round start; re-authored to 3 (within Sprout Seedling's max-3 cap).

augments.name: Ricochet Rumble
augments.description: Boulder minions are created with 60 HP.
augments.note: Boulders enter play only through Form Stone (roland3), so re-author Form Stone's summon with an hp override of 60 (summonMinion uses the override as both hp and maxHp = 'created with 60 HP', up from the base 50). Overlaps roland4/roland5 which also re-author Form Stone (multi-augment overlap on roland3).

augments.name: Bedrock Bident
augments.description: Earth Pillar marks an additional random enemy each time it is used.
augments.note: Appends a second Earth Pillar mark (duration 2, matching the base mark) on a random enemy. Picking from enemies WITHOUT an Earth Pillar mark excludes the primary target (just marked) and any already-marked enemy, honoring 'an additional' enemy.

augments.name: Stone Speaks To Stone
augments.description: Stoneform now lasts 1 additional turn, and while affected by it, Boulders deal double damage when launched with Strength From The Earth.
augments.note: Two changes. (1) Stoneform (roland4) DR duration 1 -> 2 for Roland and every Living-Stone ally; it also stamps a dedicated 'Stoneform' mark (duration 2) on Roland so the launch can detect he is Stoneform-affected (base Stoneform grants only plain damage_reduction, not Stoneform-specific). (2) Strength From The Earth (roland1) is re-authored so a launched Boulder deals 2x its current HP while Roland holds the Stoneform mark, in both the Earth-Pillar-targeted and random-target launch branches. Overlaps roland4 which also re-authors roland1 (multi-augment overlap).

augments.name: Sediment Shotgun
augments.description: Boulders are now created with 25 less HP. If Roland destroys a Boulder with Strength From The Earth, he deals 25 Piercing damage to all enemies.
augments.note: Two changes. (1) Boulders created with 25 less HP (base 50 -> 25) via Form Stone's (roland3) summon hp override (Boulders enter play only through Form Stone). (2) Appends a guarded 25 Piercing hit to all enemies onto Strength From The Earth (roland1): the guard checks the struck target was an allied minion (a Boulder Roland launched and then destroyed via the base defeat). A defeated boulder still resolves isKind/isFaction. Overlaps roland1/roland5 (Form Stone) and roland3 (roland1).

augments.name: Rockslide
augments.description: Form Stone now creates two Boulders at a time.
augments.note: Form Stone (roland3) summons 2 Boulders instead of 1. Overlaps roland1/roland4 which also re-author Form Stone (multi-augment overlap on roland3).

augments.name: Honor Guard
augments.description: The base damage reduction per ally is increased to 10
augments.note: Revered Daughter (passive ayana0) is realized as two aura triggers (source 'Revered Daughter'): a roundStart recompute and an ally-death recompute, each granting self damage_reduction = base x (living hero allies), where base = 5, doubled to 10 while the Cloister mark is up. This augment re-authors both triggers with base = 10 (doubled to 20 under Cloister). Cloister's own onExpire recompute (base skill ayana4) independently carries the same constants and would need the identical retune for perfect post-Cloister consistency; left untouched here since the augment speaks only to Revered Daughter's per-ally base.

skill.name: Cloister
skill.note: Honor Guard override of Cloister (ayana4): Revered Daughter base DR is now 10/ally, so Cloister recomputes to DOUBLED 20/ally (else 10/ally without the Cloister mark) in BOTH the immediate recompute AND the onExpire block. Same structure as base ayana4 with the mul constants doubled (5->10, 10->20).

augments.name: Guarded Meditation
augments.description: Ayana gains 30 shield for 1 turn when she uses Prayer.
augments.note: Prayer = ayana3. Appended so it fires on every Prayer cast (single or Chorus branch). Shield duration 1 turn.

augments.name: Stern Reminder
augments.description: If an enemy triggers Voice of Light, it is automatically recast on them, ignoring invulnerability and counters
augments.note: Voice of Light = ayana1. 'An enemy triggers Voice of Light' = a 'Voice of Light'-marked enemy deals new damage, firing the base 'Voice of Light' hero trigger (damageDealt, eventSource has that mark). Stern Reminder must recast BEFORE the base trigger consumes the mark, so it REMOVES the base Voice of Light trigger and re-adds it AFTER the recast trigger: array order becomes [Stern Reminder recast, Voice of Light essence]. The recast (inline useSkill ayana1 on eventSource) deals 15 and re-applies the mark, then the re-authored essence trigger grants Essence and removes the mark. Inline useSkill runs effects directly without skillDeclared, so it is inherently uncounterable and bypasses invulnerable targeting-legality ('ignoring invulnerability and counters'). No recursion: the recast's damage has eventSource=Ayana, so neither trigger's 'has mark of eventSource' guard matches.

augments.name: Answered Prayers
augments.description: Prayer makes its target Invulnerable for 1 turn if used on a target below 20 HP.
augments.note: Prayer = ayana3. prependEffect so the 'below 20 HP' check reads the target's HP AT USE TIME (before Prayer's +10 heal) and grants invulnerable 1 turn.

augments.name: Harsh Words
augments.description: Prayer and Voice of Light cause 10 more healing or damage, but no longer have a secondary effect.
augments.note: Voice of Light = ayana1 (15 damage -> 25, drop the 'Voice of Light' mark that armed the essence trigger); Prayer = ayana3 (10 heal -> 20, drop the 'Prayer' mark that armed its essence trigger). Re-authored whole per replaceSkill guidance for a value tweak; the Chorus all-valid-targets branch is preserved. Removing the marks also neutralizes the base 'Voice of Light' / 'Prayer' hero triggers ('no longer have a secondary effect'). Note: as a full replace, this supersedes other Prayer/Voice-of-Light appends (ayana2/ayana4) if drafted earlier.

augments.name: Inspiring Sweep
augments.description: Inspiring Thrust now targets all enemies but has an additional 1 turn cooldown.
augments.note: Inspiring Thrust = taryn3. Switching targeting to 'all-enemies' makes the resolver pick every living enemy, so the skill's existing 'to':'target' nodes (damage 20, the Inspiring-Thrust mark, and the Radiant Glory Refrain branch) all fan across every enemy with no effect rewrite. Cooldown 0 -> 1 ('additional 1 turn'). Metadata-only, so it stacks cleanly with other Refrain-touching augments.

augments.name: Unbreakable Protector
augments.description: Protector of the Song now also triggers when Taryn is stunned or countered.
augments.note: Protector of the Song (passive) rewards Taryn with 10 DR (1 turn) + Elemental Essence; base fires on a reflect to him. This adds two more entry points with the same reward. 'Countered' = counterFired where the countered caster is Taryn (eventSource resolves to the event's caster). 'Stunned': statusApplied exposes a 'kind' field that no Condition can read, so the trigger gates on eventUnit==self plus self currently holding a stun (has:stun) - it will also re-fire if a different status lands while Taryn is already stunned (minor over-trigger), the closest expressible reading.

augments.name: Eternal Service
augments.description: Taryn's Strategic skills cannot be stunned.
augments.note: Taryn's Strategic-tagged skills are Stalwart Shield (taryn4) and Radiant Glory (taryn5); each gains the frozen 'Unstunnable' class tag. CAVEAT: the engine's isStunnedFor keys stun-immunity off the STUN's scope, not the skill's tags, so this declarative 'Unstunnable' tag needs the stun check to also honor a skill's Unstunnable tag (a small engine addition) to take mechanical effect. Kept as the closest declarative op rather than a bespoke custom.

augments.name: Mine is the Verse
augments.description: Allies affected by Refrain reflect harmful they receive to Taryn.
augments.note: Refrain = taryn2; its ally branch applies the 2-turn 'Refrain' mark. This standing reflect trigger (same pattern as the base Stalwart Shield reflect) pulls any Harmful skill declared against a 'Refrain'-marked ally onto Taryn. The not-sameUnit guard excludes skills already aimed at Taryn and prevents redirect re-bounce.

augments.name: Hers is the Glory
augments.description: Refrain will now target a random ally when used on an enemy, or a random enemy when used on an ally.
augments.note: Refrain = taryn2. Appended so that, in addition to its chosen-target branch, it also applies the OPPOSITE branch to a random opposite-faction unit: cast on an enemy -> also mark a random ally with 'Refrain' (the helpful heal-on-cast mark); cast on an ally -> also stun a random enemy's Harmful skills for 1 turn (the harmful branch). Mirrors the base Refrain effect constants (mark duration 2, Harmful-scoped stun duration 1).

augments.name: Obsidian Duelist
augments.description: If the Black Knight defeats an enemy, his skills are enhanced for the following two turns
augments.note: 'Enhanced' in this kit is not a shared status; every skill branches on the private 'Exile' flag mark ({has mark 'Exile'}). So defeating an enemy applies the 'Exile' mark for 2 turns. On unitDied, eventSource resolves to the killer, so the guard is killer==self AND the dead unit is an enemy. CAVEAT: the base Exile passive maintains this same mark via a turnEnd custom (set while acting alone, cleared otherwise), which can refresh or clear the augment's 2-turn window; the exact base 'Exile' flag governs whether skills read as enhanced.

augments.name: Ebonsteel Charger
augments.description: The turn after activating his passive, The Nightmare Rides costs one less [8].
augments.note: The Nightmare Rides = blackknight5; [8] = unholy, its specific-cost element. 'The turn after activating his passive' is proxied by the 1-turn 'Exile' flag the Exile passive sets at turnEnd when he acted alone (present exactly the following turn). While that mark is up, a blackknight5-scoped cost_mod of -1 is applied (generic 0 -> spills to specific 2 -> 1 = one less unholy). Uses a custom node because applyStatus's StatusSpec cannot carry a per-skill skillId (buildStatus drops it), so a skill-scoped cost_mod must be installed natively (same skillId-scoped cost_mod pattern as the engine's decaySkillCost handler).

args.note: Install a blackknight5-scoped cost_mod of -1 for this (enhanced) turn; applyStatus cannot author a skillId-scoped status, hence custom.

augments.name: Devour Strength
augments.description: Oathbreaker Strike deals 15 additional damage to the primary target if Unholy Aura is affecting more than 3 targets
augments.note: Oathbreaker Strike = blackknight1; Unholy Aura = blackknight3, which applies the named outgoing_damage_mod 'Unholy Aura'. 'Affecting more than 3 targets' = count of units (any faction) currently holding that status > 3 (base Unholy Aura hits all 6 units, so this is the non-enhanced case; the enhanced enemies-only cast affects 3 and does not qualify). Appends bonus damage to the primary 'target'; dtype left normal since the oracle does not call the bonus piercing.

augments.name: Unholy Fortitude
augments.description: If Dead or Alive successfully redirects an ability, the Black Knight gains Elemental Essence
augments.note: Dead or Alive = blackknight4; while enhanced it applies the 1-turn 'Dead or Alive' mark that keys the standing reflect trigger pulling allies' harmful onto him. When that reflect resolves, a skillRedirected event fires; this trigger reacts to it while the 'Dead or Alive' mark is present (the window in which that redirect is the only one active) and grants self Elemental Essence. Gated on the mark rather than the redirect destination because no Condition reads a redirect's 'to' (same limitation as the base reflect gating).

augments.name: Oathbreaker's Blade
augments.description: Oathbreaker Strike deals 10 damage to the target's allies while enhanced.
augments.note: Oathbreaker Strike = blackknight1. 'While enhanced' = the private 'Exile' flag OR the 'The Nightmare Rides' ultimate override (both are the enhanced conditions the base strike reads). 'The target's allies' = the enemies other than the primary target: a short-lived private mark tags the primary target so the 10-damage splash can select {enemies without that mark}, then the mark is removed in the same resolution (a forEach can't compare to the primary because it rebinds 'target'/'it' to the current unit). dtype normal since the oracle does not call the splash piercing.

augments.name: Leeching Briars
augments.description: When Maggie gains Elemental Essence from Bramblelash, she heals 5 health for every stack of Curse of Thorns on her.
augments.note: Bramblelash is Maggie's only Elemental Essence source, so a generic 'gains Elemental Essence' trigger satisfies 'from Bramblelash'. Modeled as the accepted keeper-style statusApplied proxy (the applied-status kind is not directly inspectable, so gated on Maggie holding elemental_essence right after the application).

augments.name: Fractal Thorns
augments.description: Bramblelash, Thornburst, and Grasping Vines deal 5 additional damage if Maggie has 2 or more stacks of Curse of Thorns. This damage increases to 10 when she has 4 or more.
augments.note: +5 at >=2 Curse of Thorns, +10 at >=4. Bramblelash: bonus mirrors its single target. Thornburst: bonus mirrors its branch (all enemies at >=3 Curse, else the single target). Grasping Vines' bonus is folded into its delayed, mark-guarded scheduled hit via replaceSkill to avoid same-delay scheduler ordering with the base mark-removal.

skill.name: Grasping Vines
skill.note: Grasping Vines with the Fractal Thorns bonus folded into its delayed, mark-guarded hit (Curse-of-Thorns bonus evaluated at resolution time). Base behaviour otherwise unchanged.

augments.name: Mutual Assurance
augments.description: When Maggie's Shield is damaged while Bramblebarrier is active, she deals 5 Piercing damage to the enemy team.
augments.note: Bramblebarrier is Maggie's barrier (the Shield granted by Cursed Resistance); the base kit models it as her plain Shield pool, so a shieldDamaged event on Maggie already encodes 'while Bramblebarrier is active'. shieldDamaged identifies the shield owner via eventUnit (per the Saya/Roland precedent).

augments.name: Hold Still
augments.description: Enemies stunned by Grasping Vines take 15 more damage from Bramblelash.
augments.note: Grasping Vines is Maggie's only stun source, so 'stunned by Grasping Vines' is approximated by the Bramblelash target simply carrying a stun. Extra 15 appended to Bramblelash, gated on the target being stunned.

augments.name: Scornful Thorns
augments.description: Targets marked by Bramblelash receive 10 additional damage from Thornburst.
augments.note: Thornburst deals +10 to each target it hits that carries the Bramblelash mark; the bonus mirrors Thornburst's own targeting (all enemies at >=3 Curse of Thorns, otherwise the single target).

augments.name: Darkest Hour
augments.description: If the target of Nightwrap has 4 Stacks of Deepening Shadows, they become Invulnerable if they are an ally or Stunned if they are an enemy. Effect lasts 1 turn.
augments.note: 'has 4 Stacks' modeled as >=4 (matching the base laria2/laria3 'already had 4 stacks' convention). Appended after Nightwrap's base effect, so the count includes Nightwrap's own +1 stack (timing ambiguity noted). Both statuses last 1 turn.

augments.name: Noble Thief
augments.description: If Laria uses Nightwrap on a target without Elemental Essence, she gives them Elemental Essence if they are an ally, and generates a Generic energy if they are an enemy.
augments.note: Complements Nightwrap's base 'if target HAS Elemental Essence, Laria gains it' branch. 'generates a Generic energy' grants Laria (the caster) 1 generic energy.

augments.name: Nightblade
augments.description: Nightwrap now counts stacks of Deepening Shadows on Laria if she is using it on an enemy
augments.note: Re-authors Nightwrap so the enemy-branch damage scales on Laria's own Deepening Shadows stacks instead of the target's. The ally heal, the essence-steal, and the +1 stack on the target are unchanged.

skill.name: Nightwrap
skill.note: Nightblade: enemy-branch +5/stack now reads Laria's Deepening Shadows (of:self); ally branch still reads the target's.

augments.name: Nightwalker
augments.description: Characters with 3 or more stacks of Deepening Shadows Bypass.
augments.note: Standing rule over all characters, applied reactively: when any status is applied to a unit now holding >=3 Deepening Shadows, grant it an unconditional conditional_bypass (bypassCond absent), so bypassesAgainst makes its outgoing damage ignore DR+Shield. Not stripped if stacks later drop (Deepening Shadows is round-permanent).

augments.name: Vanishing Powder
augments.description: When a character receives their 3rd stack of Deepening Shadows, they gain the effects of Vanish.
augments.note: 'the effects of Vanish' = 15 Damage Reduction (named 'Vanish') for 3 turns, applied to the character. Fires on statusApplied when the recipient's Deepening Shadows stackCount is exactly 3. Vanish's 'or until she uses a new skill' early-exit is Laria-specific (her laria4 trigger), so non-Laria characters simply keep the 3-turn DR.

augments.name: Painful Memories
augments.description: Reveal Hidden Truth lowers its targets damage dealt by 10 for 1 turn.
augments.note: Appends an attacker-side outgoing_damage_mod of -10 for 1 turn to Reveal Hidden Truth's target.

augments.name: Somnic Adaptation
augments.description: Xyris gains 5 permanent Shield each time he gains Elemental Essence.
augments.note: Keeper-style statusApplied proxy for 'gains Elemental Essence' (applied-status kind is not directly inspectable, so gated on Xyris holding elemental_essence right after the application). 5 permanent (duration null) Shield.

augments.name: Return to the Dream
augments.description: If Xyris has Elemental Essence when he uses Enter the Dreamscape, its cooldown is set to 1.
augments.note: Re-authors Enter the Dreamscape so the essence check runs FIRST (before the skill grants Xyris its own Elemental Essence, which would otherwise always satisfy the condition). Base cooldown is 3, so modifyCooldown delta -2 realizes 'set to 1'. CAVEAT (per the Sera 'Eyes of Vengeance' precedent): the engine sets currentCd = cooldown AFTER a skill's effects run, so a skill reducing its OWN cooldown mid-cast needs the engine to fold pending self-cd deltas; modifyCooldown is the correct primitive regardless.

skill.name: Enter the Dreamscape
skill.note: Return to the Dream: pre-cast Elemental Essence check reduces this cast's cooldown to 1 (delta -2 from base 3). Base damage/Helpful-stun/essence-per-turn otherwise unchanged.

augments.name: Neverending Nightmares
augments.description: Twisted Nightmares becomes permanent if used on an enemy affected by Enter the Dreamscape.
augments.note: 'affected by Enter the Dreamscape' is detected via the target carrying a stun (Enter the Dreamscape's Helpful-scoped stun is Xyris's only stun source). Re-authors Twisted Nightmares so both its 'Twisted Nightmares' mark and the AoE->single custom hook are permanent (duration null) against such a target, else the base 1 turn.

skill.name: Twisted Nightmares

then.note: Permanent AoE->single while the target holds the (now permanent) Twisted Nightmares mark.

skill.note: Neverending Nightmares: 20 damage; then the Twisted Nightmares mark + AoE->single last permanently vs a target 'affected by Enter the Dreamscape' (proxied by the target being stunned), otherwise 1 turn.

augments.name: Twisted Replica
augments.description: Dream Reflection minions are created with the countered enemy's current HP.
augments.note: The Dream Reflection is summoned inside Xyris's standing 'Somnic Apparition' counter trigger (base hp 35). Since triggers cannot be patched in place, the base trigger is removed and re-added with the summon HP set to the countered enemy's (eventSource) current HP; the clone-skill and mark-cleanup steps are preserved verbatim.

effect.note: Clone the countered skill onto the fresh Dream Reflection; Specific costs re-elemented to Xyris' current element.

augments.name: Resurgent Revival
augments.description: If Fate is revived using This Is Not The End, he no longer prevents healing from his allies from affecting him.
augments.note: Dwindling Flame heal_locks Fate to self-only healing each roundStart. This adds a reactive trigger that fires right after the base 'This Is Not The End' revive: that base trigger stamps 'TINTE Spent' on Fate as part of reviving, and eventUnit==self identifies Fate as the unit revived, so the pair detects 'Fate was revived by TINTE' and removes his heal_lock so allied heals reach him. Appended, so it fires after the base revive. Caveat: removeTrigger is source-granular and Dwindling Flame's roundStart lock shares its source with two live auras, so that one lock cannot be suppressed individually; it re-applies next roundStart, so the unlock holds for the remainder of the current round.

augments.name: Azure Lure
augments.description: Will-o'-wisp no longer gives Fate's team Shield. Instead, the enemy team has their Helpful skills stunned while it is active.
augments.note: Only the 10 team Shield clause changes; the self 5 Affliction, the Will-o'-wisp mark, and its retaliation trigger are untouched. The enemy stun uses Stun's scope {tag:'Helpful',mode:'only'} so it stops ONLY their Helpful skills, for the 2-turn Will-o'-wisp window.

skill.name: Will-o'-wisp
skill.note: Azure Lure: the base 10 team Shield is dropped; instead the enemy team takes a 2-turn Helpful-only Stun (scope tag 'Helpful', mode 'only' stops ONLY their Helpful skills) for the life of the 2-turn Will-o'-wisp window. The self 5 Affliction, the Will-o'-wisp mark, and its retaliation trigger are unchanged.

augments.name: Vulpus Arcana
augments.description: Vulpus Incendia and Vulpus Crystallia can now be used without interrupting Channeling.
augments.note: Vulpus Incendia = fate3, Vulpus Crystallia = fate4. 'used without interrupting Channeling' maps exactly to the per-skill doesNotInterrupt flag (the scheduler skips clearing the caster's channeling status when a doesNotInterrupt skill is used).

augments.name: Deja Vu
augments.description: Enemies that don't trigger Fox's Cunning during its duration will have their cooldowns paralyzed for 2 turns.
augments.note: Fox's Cunning = fate5; casting it opens a 1-turn window (its 'Fox's Cunning' self-mark) during which the standing trigger Fox-Fires any enemy who uses a new skill ('triggering' it). Deja Vu tags every enemy at cast with a 1-turn 'Deja Vu Watch' whose onExpire paralyzes the holder for 2 turns ('paralysis' = cooldowns do not advance = 'cooldowns paralyzed'); the re-authored Fox's Cunning trigger removes that watch from any enemy who acts, so only enemies who did NOT trigger Fox's Cunning keep the watch to its natural lapse. Both watch and window are 1-turn Fate-anchored marks, so they expire together at Fate's next turn-end.

trigger.note: Base Fox's Cunning trigger (marks any enemy who uses a new skill during the window with Fox Fire) plus Deja Vu: also strips the 'Deja Vu Watch' mark from any enemy that uses a skill during the window, so only enemies who never acted keep the watch and are paralyzed when it lapses.

augments.name: Once More, Together
augments.description: This Is Not The End's trigger limit is now per allied Hero (each Hero can be revived once per round.)
augments.note: Re-authors the single 'This Is Not The End' unitDied trigger: the base consumed the window for the whole team and locked once-per-round via 'TINTE Spent'; this makes it once-per-Hero (see the trigger note). Authored against the base kit; if drafted alongside Resurgent Revival (which keys off the base 'TINTE Spent' stamp) the two independent readings of this trigger interact and the last-applied wins.

trigger.note: Once More, Together makes the revive per-Hero: the consumed protection is removed only from the revived hero (not the whole team), TINTE Armed is left intact so other protected heroes can still be revived inside the 2-turn window, and no global 'TINTE Spent' lock is applied; the revived hero instead gets a round-permanent 'Once More: Revived' mark that the when-clause excludes, so each hero gets exactly one revive per round. fate6.requires (gated on 'TINTE Spent', now never applied) therefore stops blocking recast, consistent with the per-hero rule.

augments.name: Sign In Blood
augments.description: Allies receive 10 Affliction damage when triggering Scratch's Deal skills, but they gain Elemental Essence when doing so.
augments.note: 'Scratch's Deal skills' = the three basic Deals (Defeat=scratch1, Save=scratch2, Realize=scratch3); the moment a target 'triggers' a Deal is that Deal's standing skillUsed reaction. Each of the three reactions is re-authored with a leading clause: if the triggering unit (eventSource) is an ally, deal it 10 Affliction and grant it Elemental Essence. The clause is prepended so it reads the Deal mark before the base reaction removes it. The Save boon reaction is left alone so an ally triggering Save is charged once. The ultimate 'Deal: Know Your Fate' has no trigger and is unaffected.

trigger.note: Base scratch1 reaction (20 Affliction punishment unless Faustian-flagged; Scratch gains Essence; consume the mark) plus Sign In Blood: a leading clause that, if the triggering unit is an ally, deals it 10 Affliction and grants it Elemental Essence; prepended so it runs before the mark is consumed.

Base scratch2 trigger-half (end the boon; permanently Isolate unless Faustian-flagged; Scratch gains Essence; consume the mark) plus Sign In Blood: a leading ally clause (10 Affliction + Elemental Essence to the triggering ally), prepended so it sees the Deal holder before the mark is consumed.

Base scratch3 reaction (Stun 1 unless Faustian-flagged; Scratch gains Essence; consume the mark; the cost_mod discount is a separate status left alone) plus Sign In Blood: a leading ally clause (10 Affliction + Elemental Essence to the triggering ally), prepended so it sees the Deal holder before the mark is consumed.

augments.name: Absolute Power
augments.description: Heroes affected by Deal: Defeat Your Enemies ignore stuns and counters.
augments.note: Deal: Defeat Your Enemies = scratch1; its target is always given the 'Deal: Defeat Your Enemies' mark, so 'Heroes affected by' it = the mark holder. Appends two statuses to the target for the 1-turn mark window: uncounterable (their skills cannot be countered/reflected = 'ignore counters'), and non_damage_ignore for 'ignore stuns'. Fidelity caveat: the engine has no stun-only immunity, so non_damage_ignore is the closest real status and is broader (it also ignores other harmful non-damage effects). Durations track the 1-turn Deal: Defeat window.

augments.name: Everything Must Go
augments.description: Each round, the first time Scratch falls below 30 HP, his next non-Ultimate Deal skill applies all other non-Ultimate Deal skills.
augments.note: Non-Ultimate Deals = scratch1/2/3. A reactive trigger watches Scratch's own HP: the first damage event that leaves him below 30 while unlocked arms 'EMG Armed' and sets the round-scoped lock 'EMG Fired' (duration null clears at round end, giving the once-per-round reset). Each non-Ultimate Deal is then appended with a cascade: if armed, it consumes the flag FIRST (so the nested casts don't re-cascade) then useSkills the other two Deals on the same target ('applies all other non-Ultimate Deal skills'). useSkill runs inline and emits no skillUsed, so the Deal reactions don't double-fire. Caveat: the arm hook keys on damageDealt, so HP lost via non-damage healthLoss would not arm it.

augments.name: Bump Those Numbers
augments.description: Scratch's Deal skills no longer have a cooldown, but can only affect each Hero once per round.
augments.note: 'Deal skills' read as every skill named 'Deal:' -> scratch1, scratch2, scratch3, and the ultimate scratch6; setSkillMeta zeroes their cooldown AND sets excludeMarkedTargets:'Deal-Locked'. The second clause ('can only affect each Hero once per round') is implemented: each Deal appends a stamp of the round-permanent 'Deal-Locked' mark on its target, and legalTargets excludes any unit already bearing it. The mark is duration:null (round-permanent) and wiped at startRound, giving automatic per-round reset. The lock is SHARED across all Deals ('each Hero once per round' collectively).

augments.name: Dramatic Irony
augments.description: Deal: Defeat Your Enemies and Deal: Save Your Friends are now invisible until triggered.
augments.note: Deal: Defeat = scratch1, Deal: Save = scratch2. Modeled as real isHidden: each Deal becomes Invisible, so its cast leaves no telegraph and the boon it arms is stamped invisible (redactState hides it from the opponent). 'Until triggered' falls out for free — when the Deal fires, the payoff runs in a fresh trigger context (visible) and the armed boon lapses, so the opponent only ever sees the resolution, never the set-up.

augments.name: Veiled Beat
augments.description: Sand Quake's cost is reduced by 1 [65], but Desert Veil only applies Veiled for 1 turn.
augments.note: Sand Quake = aramao2; 'cost reduced by 1' lowers its generic from 2 to 1 (the [65] is a reference-lint artifact, not content). Desert Veil = aramao4; 'only applies Veiled for 1 turn' rewrites every Veiled it grants (both branches) from duration 2 to 1 via replaceSkill (base nodes carry no ids).

skill.name: Desert Veil
skill.note: Targets an allied Hero or Aramao. If targeting Aramao: Veil Aramao and a random OTHER allied Hero. If targeting an ally: Veil that ally and Aramao and swap their formation positions. Veiled Beat shortens every Veiled this skill applies to 1 turn.

augments.name: Hidden Oasis
augments.description: If Mirage Trap expires without being triggered, the affected enemy heals the allied Hero directly across from them for 25 HP.
augments.note: Mirage Trap = aramao3. A trap that fires (its counter) removes the mark early, so 'expires without being triggered' is exactly the mark's natural onExpire. Both trap-mark variants get an onExpire that heals the allied Hero across from the trapped enemy for 25 (see the effect note for why this needs a custom fn). Re-authored via replaceSkill because the base mark nodes carry no ids.

skill.name: Mirage Trap
skill.note: Targets an enemy for 1 turn (this skill is hidden/concealed -- an isHidden presentation flag, noted). If that enemy is across from Aramao, arm the counter against their first NON-Strategic skill; else against their first Strategic skill (the two standing 'Mirage Trap' counter triggers). Hidden Oasis: each trap mark gets an onExpire that fires only on a natural (untriggered) lapse, healing the ally across from the trapped enemy for 25.

onExpire.note: onExpire runs with caster=Aramao, target=holder(the trapped enemy). Heals Aramao's living hero teammate standing in the holder's slot ('the allied Hero directly across from them') for 25. Needs custom: no selector expresses 'my ally in an arbitrary enemy's slot' (the 'across' selector is self-relative to Aramao, not to the holder); mirrors aramao1's swapWithAllyAcrossFromTarget.

onExpire runs with caster=Aramao, target=holder(the trapped enemy). Heals Aramao's living hero teammate standing in the holder's slot ('the allied Hero directly across from them') for 25. Needs custom: no selector expresses 'my ally in an arbitrary enemy's slot' (the 'across' selector is self-relative to Aramao, not to the holder); mirrors aramao1's swapWithAllyAcrossFromTarget.

augments.name: Vanishing Act
augments.description: After Desert Veil finishes applying Veiled, the untargeted allied Hero is Veiled for 2 turns.
augments.note: Desert Veil = aramao4; it Veils two allied Heroes, leaving one 'untargeted'. Appends a final applyStatus that Veils, for 2 turns, the allied Hero who still lacks Veiled (selector filter allies+self, kind hero, without veiled) -- i.e. the one Desert Veil did not cover. Runs after the base veils, so it targets exactly the leftover hero (any ally already Veiled from another source is skipped).

augments.name: Wraithblade
augments.description: If Aramao is Veiled, Desert Knife deals 10 more damage and extends the duration of his Veiled effects by 1 turn.
augments.note: Desert Knife = aramao1. Appends a clause gated on Aramao being Veiled at cast: deal 10 more Piercing to the target (base 10 -> 20 total) and extend his Veiled effects by 1 turn (modifyStatus veiled durationDelta +1 on self). Runs after the base hit/swap, so the extra damage still lands on the same target.

augments.name: Dune Step
augments.description: Trial of Sands lasts 1 more turn. While it is active, all enemy Heroes are considered to be across from Aramao, and all allied Heroes are considered to be adjacent to him.
augments.note: Trial of the Sands = aramao6. 'lasts 1 more turn' bumps its self-mark from 3 to 4 turns via replaceSkill (which also extends the re-veil and retaliate windows gated on that mark). The positional clause ('while active, all enemy Heroes count as across from Aramao and all allied Heroes as adjacent to him') redefines how the across/adjacent selectors resolve for Aramao -- a scheduler/selector-level override that no status or effect node can express (the same class as aramao1's custom swap and Scratch's targeting rulings). It is recorded here as a ruling keyed on Aramao holding the 'Trial of the Sands' mark; when honored it widens his passive +5/Essence to every enemy and his adjacent-only heals (Heart of the Desert) to the whole team.

skill.name: Trial of the Sands
skill.note: Installs the 'Trial of the Sands' window on Aramao and immediately shuffles his team's formation once. While the window is up, two standing triggers fire: (re-veil) veils all allied heroes at each turn-end, and (retaliate) uses Desert Knife on any enemy who uses a Harmful skill on Aramao. Dune Step: the Trial window mark lasts 4 turns instead of 3.

augments.name: Vengeful Tempest
augments.description: Synthetic Skyblade deals 5 additional base damage, costs an additional Generic, and will consume 2 stacks of Eyes of Vengeance.
augments.note: Re-authors Synthetic Skyblade (sera1) with three edits: base hit 15->20 (skyblade.hit), cost.generic 1->2, and the marked-branch Eyes of Vengeance consume -1->-2. Entry condition (target has >=1 stack) is unchanged per prose; if only 1 stack is present the -2 delta can drive the count negative (modifyStatus does not clamp) — a minor faithfulness artifact of 'will consume 2 stacks'. The Divinity Engine (sera6) rider branches are preserved.

augments.name: Proto-Prophecy
augments.description: Enemies targeted by Heavenly Parry deal 10 reduced damage for their next turn. This effect is invisible.
augments.note: Appends to Heavenly Parry (sera3): the targeted enemy gets outgoing_damage_mod magnitude -10 ('deals 10 less') for 1 turn ('their next turn'). 'This effect is invisible' = invisible:true on that status spec, so redactState hides the debuff from the debuffed enemy.

augments.name: Ire of the Storm
