augments.description: If Energized Wingstorm consumes 3 or more stacks of Eyes of Vengeance, it will deal an additional 15 Piercing damage to each target the following turn.
augments.note: Appends to Energized Wingstorm (sera2). Wingstorm consumes exactly 1 Eyes of Vengeance stack per marked enemy, so '3 or more stacks consumed' == '3 or more enemies were marked at cast', tested by counting enemies carrying the Eyes of Vengeance stack. modifyStatus does not delete a stack at magnitude 0, so this count is stable after the base skill's consume (a pre-existing magnitude-0 stack could overcount — noted). 'each target' = all enemies; 'the following turn' = schedule delayTurns 1.

augments.name: Unto Others
augments.description: Proactivity Protocol now deals 15 normal Damage and heals for 25, but gains an additional 1 turn cooldown.
augments.note: Re-authors Proactivity Protocol (sera5): the self-hit becomes 15 normal (was 20 True), the ally heal 20->25, cooldown 4->5 ('additional 1 turn cooldown' on the frozen base of 4). The 20 Shield to self is unmentioned in the prose and preserved.

augments.name: Fueled by Vengeance
augments.description: Divinity Engine lasts an additional turn for each of Sera's dead allies.
augments.note: Re-authors Divinity Engine (sera6): both statuses (non_damage_ignore and the 'Divinity Engine' mark) now last 2 + (dead allied heroes) turns instead of a flat 2. Dead allies = {faction:allies, alive:false, kind:hero} (Sera is alive at cast, so self is excluded).

augments.name: Twin Storms
augments.description: Galazax can now Channel up to 2 separate copies of The Skies Darken.
augments.note: The Skies Darken = The Sky Darkens (galazax1). The engine models one channel per skill id (the 'channeling' status is named by skill id), so two independent concurrent copies of the same Channel skill have no DSL/engine primitive — relaxing the base 'requires' gate alone would not spawn a second damage-dealing instance. Escaped to a custom patch documenting the intent (max 2 concurrent copies of galazax1).

augments.name: Chain Lightning
augments.description: Lightning Strikes now deals 10 damage to the primary target and 5 to all other enemies, and becomes Piercing.
augments.note: Re-authors Lightning Strikes (galazax2) as all-Piercing. The DSL has no 'all enemies except the primary target' selector (forEach rebinds `target` to the iterated unit), so the exact 10/5 split is produced by 5 Piercing to every enemy plus 5 Piercing to the primary target (primary nets 10, others 5). Minor artifact: the primary registers two damage events, so The Storm Builds passive lays 2 stacks on it instead of 1.

augments.name: The Voice Above
augments.description: The Heavens Speak now costs [65] less and no longer cancels Channeled skills.
augments.note: The Heavens Speak = galazax4. [65] = Generic energy (elements.json id 65), so cost.generic 1->0 (specific stays 1). 'No longer cancels Channeled skills' = doesNotInterrupt:true (using it keeps The Sky Darkens channeling). Both are metadata edits, so setSkillMeta.

augments.name: Deafening Silence
augments.description: Thunder Deafens has its cooldown reduced by 1, but it no longer causes Galazax to ignore damage.
augments.note: Re-authors Thunder Deafens (galazax5): cooldown 3->2 and the damage_ignore effect removed (untargetable kept). doesNotInterrupt kept.

augments.name: Looming Grudge
augments.description: A random enemy Hero starts each round with 3 stacks of The Storm Builds.
augments.note: A roundStart trigger applying 3 The Storm Builds stacks (duration null = round-permanent, matching the base resource) to a random enemy hero.

augments.name: Scarlet Somersault Crash
augments.description: Prisma Maneuver skills mark Prisma Crimson for 3 turns when she uses them or they are used on her. If she is marked by all 3 Prisma Maneuver skills, Crimson Crash deals 40 more damage.
augments.note: The brief's baseSkills lists only the three category headers (trinity1/2/3); the concrete per-color skills carry the real behaviour and are Trinity's own (owner=trinity in the frozen kit). The three Prisma Maneuver skills = Prisma Vault(trinitycrimson2), Prisma Whirl(trinityazure2), Prisma Launch(trinitysaffron2); Crimson Crash=trinitycrimson3. Each maneuver marks Prisma Crimson with a distinct 'Somersault: <skill>' mark for 3 turns when Prisma Crimson is its caster (self) OR its target — the OR gate uses a {faction:allies,template:'Prisma Crimson'} identity check in sameUnit. Crimson Crash is Prisma Crimson's own skill, so `self` is Prisma Crimson for the all-3 test; +40 flat when all three marks are held. LIMITATION: augment patches apply to the hero unit's skills, while these live on the Ranger minion templates — reachable only if the augment system re-applies patches to summoned minions (the standing Trinity minion-kit caveat). Mark names are internal.

augments.name: Grand Sonata
augments.description: Prisma Whirl now applies Sonata Azure instead of its normal effect.
augments.note: Prisma Whirl=trinityazure2, Sonata Azure=trinityazure3 (both Prisma Azure's skills). Re-authors Prisma Whirl's effect tree to invoke Sonata Azure inline (useSkill by self on target), keeping Prisma Whirl's metadata. 'Instead of its normal effect' means the base whirl priming / lens-buddy branch (and thus the whirl-retaliation triggers) no longer fire. Tags kept as Prisma Whirl's (Strategic/Instant) though the applied effect is now Harmful. Minion-skill reachability caveat as in Trinity's kit.

augments.name: Golden Fantasia
augments.description: Saffron Beam now affects all enemies, but using it Shatters Prisma Saffron for 1 turn.
augments.note: Re-authors Saffron Beam (trinitysaffron3): 'affects all enemies' extends its full effect (10 damage + taunt onto the casting Saffron) to the whole enemy team (targeting all-enemies), and using it applies Shatter to self (Prisma Saffron) for 1 turn. Minion-skill reachability caveat as in Trinity's kit.

augments.name: The Power of Friendship
augments.description: Prisma Lens skills deal 0 damage to their target, increased by 5 for each other Lens skill already used on them this turn.
augments.note: Prisma Lens skills = Ruby Lens(trinitycrimson1), Sapphire Lens(trinityazure1), Citrine Lens(trinitysaffron1). Each now deals 5 x (other Lens skills already used on the target this turn) to its target: a per-turn 'Lens Applied' stack on the target counts prior lenses, and the damage (added BEFORE incrementing) reads that count, so the current lens is not self-counted and the first lens deals 5x0 = 0. duration 1 approximates 'this turn'. Minion-skill reachability caveat as in Trinity's kit.

augments.name: Kibi, the Mascot
augments.description: At the start of each round, a random Prismari Ranger has their maximum HP increased by 20.
augments.note: No Effect op raises maxHp, so a roundStart trigger carries a custom node ('increaseMaxHp', +20) targeting a random allied minion — Trinity's only minions are the three Prismari Rangers. Fires after the passive's roundStart summon so the Rangers exist.
